title: Backward integral Gronwall inequality on [a, b]
statement: Let a ≤ b, Λ ≥ 0 and C be real numbers and let f : ℝ → ℝ be Lebesgue integrable on [a, b]. Assume that f(s) ≤ C + Λ ∫_{(s,b]} f(τ) dτ for every s ∈ [a, b]. Then f(s) ≤ C e^{Λ(b − s)} for every s ∈ [a, b]. (No sign condition on C or on f is needed.)
lean_statement: ∀ (a b Λ C : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 ≤ Λ → IntegrableOn f (Icc a b) → (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, f s ≤ C + Λ * ∫ τ in Ioc s b, f τ) → ∀ s ∈ Icc a b, f s ≤ C * Real.exp (Λ * (b - s))
